short_description: Count a chosen spoken word with local speech recognition and a separate pixel firework for every match.
description: Count a chosen spoken word with local speech recognition and a separate pixel firework for every match. Set a word, start the Mac companion, and place the bar near your screen. Say ‘amazing’ three times during a presentation and you get three hits. The counter is shared with the display. Wheel switches to the target editor, click changes the goal or refreshes the count, and Start sets a new target five hits above the current count.
